index.Description: Label value in the tissue segmentation (input to --modality dsegtissue, and the labels HippUnfold's tissue models and templates use).

name.Description: Name of the tissue or landmark.

abbreviation.Description: Short name of the tissue or landmark.

description.Description: Anatomical definition of the label, for manual segmentation.

laplace_role.Description: How the label enters the Laplace coordinates (config laplace_labels): the domain, or a source (src, value 0) or sink (value 1) boundary of the AP, PD or IO coordinate, for the hipp and dentate surfaces. Swapping a src and sink label reverses that coordinate and mirrors the unfolded space.
